title: Materials Around Us
text:
Many things are made from different materials. A table can be made from wood. A cup can be made from glass. Glass is smooth and cold.

Some clothes are made from wool. Wool is soft and warm. Stone is hard and rough. A rock on the beach feels rough.

questions.text: What is a table made from?
How is wool described in the text?
Which material would most likely be good for a winter coat?
Why would sitting on a rock on the beach be uncomfortable?

vocabulary.definition: flat and even, with no rough parts
easy to press and comfortable to touch
having a fairly high temperature, but not hot

paragraph_translations: Birçok şey farklı malzemelerden yapılır. Bir masa ahşaptan yapılabilir. Bir fincan camdan yapılabilir. Cam pürüzsüz ve soğuktur.
Bazı kıyafetler yünden yapılır. Yün yumuşak ve sıcaktır. Taş serttir ve pürüzlüdür. Sahildeki bir kaya pürüzlü hissettirir.
